description:
## Test-first scope
Engine.Api currently drops existing per-message transcript_id/message_id when flattening attachments. Wrap each descriptor with these IDs and extend Channels.Events/Api and CommunicationMedia hydration contract. Reuse ExecutionHistory origin IDs; parent/root messages must not be bound to child projection ID. Sign versioned canonical_attachment claim containing both UUIDs with existing locator, separate from durable version-1 source metadata. Use Record sanitation/source helpers/handle issuance, not new serializers.
Scoped hydration follows an already-authorized Engine read and bypasses author equality by selecting the canonical policy, NOT by setting skip_permissions. No extra reverse Engine auth dispatch or provider IO at hydration. Preserve unscoped author-bound behavior, batch bounds/order, per-item unavailable descriptors, truthful transport failure, cursor semantics and unchanged stored messages. Confidentiality is not authentication; scope comes only from server-owned projection.
## Modules/tests
Engine.Api; Channels.Events; Channels.Api; CommunicationMedia. execution_history_test.exs admission/delta A/B, parent and Replicated placement; communication_media_test.exs scoped claim/schema and events_test.exs wrapper/actor/order. Assert no handles/claims persist and no IO. Resolve disclosed existing-test approval before changing that scenario; retain legacy malformed-source and transport-failure coverage.

Planning only: leave open; implementation has not started. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/action-reuse.md and relevant Engine/Channels/materialization guides. Write tests before implementation; reuse existing helpers rather than duplicate permission, projection or source-validation logic. No migration, new tool, attachment ACL, provider membership query, generic invoke, or attachment-specific Engine event.
